subject: general
question: The average of the resultant of three times of A and four times of B is 17. Also, the average of the resultant of four times of A and three times of B is 18. The sum of A and B is:
solution:
**Given:**

The average of the resultant of three times of A and four times of B is 17

The average of the resultant of four times of A and three times of B is 18

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

3A + 4B = 17 × 2

⇒ 3A + 4B = 34 ----(i)

Again,

4A + 3B = 18 × 2

⇒ 4A + 3B = 36 ----(ii)

By adding eq (i) and (ii) we get,

7A + 7B = 70

⇒ A + B = 10

**∴ The sum of A and B is 10.**
